page.overview:
Who is Iguana?

King Lizard † (leader) Supreme Lizard † (leader) Salamander † Komodo Dragon † Gila Monster (M.I.A) Gecko (M.I.A)

True to her name, Iguana's outfit is obviously based on the Iguana species, wearing a dark and light lime green suit, and the lizard league symbol on her chest area. She also has a spikey like mohawk hairstyle underneath her mask, and has very sharp claws.

Iguana is mainly portrayed as a cold mute fighter, or sometimes irritated, like when she was annoyed by Supreme Lizard's embarrassing speech.
